content.comment_body: Is it possible to rename M flags? I have successfully edited the I/O names, but the flags do not appear in the available list. I am currently using [product_name] version [version_no].
It is not possible to change the names of M flags. Only within individual block properties can you assign a name.

analysis.insight_summary: Users want to rename or label M flags within [product_name], but the software does not offer this option. This limitation decreases flexibility in organizing and clarifying program logic, whereas I/O elements allow such customization.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to give custom names to M flags, improving clarity and project organization in the same way as with I/O elements.
